name: Madagascar
headline: Madagascar: +3.1% growth in 2025, 8.0% inflation, debt 48% of GDP
sections: Madagascar is a $19.5 billion economy (2025), the world's 138th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +3.1% in 2025, close to the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $1,952 at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 13.1% of GDP (2024).
Consumer prices rose 8.0% in 2025, above typical targets. Unemployment stood at 3.0% (2025), below the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 5.2% (2025).
Gross government debt is 48% of GDP (2025), a moderate level that has fallen from 53% in 2020. The general government balance is −2.1% of GDP (2025).
The current account balance is −6.0% of GDP (2025), a sizeable external financing need. Trade equals 54% of GDP (2025), a fairly open economy. Net FDI inflows were 4.5% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 50% of GDP by 2031, broadly stable from today's level. Life expectancy is 63.8 years (2024). Population: 31.4 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
